mainEntity.name: Should I consider solar panels as part of an energy-efficient remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Solar panels can be an excellent addition to an energy-efficient remodel, significantly reducing or even eliminating your electricity bills and increasing your home's energy independence. They work best when the home's energy consumption has already been minimized through other upgrades like insulation and efficient appliances. Before committing, consider your roof's condition, sun exposure, and local utility regulations, as these factors directly impact solar panel effectiveness and payback period.
